current_package_source.hash_definition: SHA-256 of a sorted manifest whose rows are '<file-sha256>  <relative-path>\n' for src/**/*.php, src/**/*.json, and config/samsara.php

methodology.official_operation_definition: Each HTTP operation declaration in the pinned OpenAPI paths object; duplicate placeholder-spelling aliases remain separate declarations.
methodology.package_operation_definition: A unique normalized method/path that a public concrete Resource method emitted during a fake-HTTP runtime capture; unsupported inherited methods rejected before HTTP are excluded.
methodology.path_normalization: Path placeholder names and captured numeric sample IDs normalize to {}; duplicate slashes and trailing slash are removed.
methodology.matched_definition: A package unique wire key equals an official normalized wire key. The two duplicate official legacy aliases are official-only, so matched declarations and matched unique keys are both 187.
methodology.changed_definition: A matched operation with a confirmed current source-versus-contract mismatch in method/path, fixed parameter placement/serialization, request wrapper, response wrapper/mapper, error mapping, or pagination behavior. Proof limits are recorded separately and are not silently classified as equality.
methodology.stage_definition: Preview APIs tag => preview; else Beta APIs tag => beta; all others => stable residual. The contract has no affirmative GA marker.
methodology.schema_proof_boundary: The SDK intentionally accepts opaque arrays/Builder.where values and maps many responses to open Fluent entities or raw arrays. This proves transport compatibility, not local field validation, generated-model equality, server runtime behavior, or undocumented behavior.

difference_classes.docs-only: authority/proof wording without package wire behavior change

root_baseline_disposition.reason: docs/api-maintenance.md explicitly defines root samsara.json as a historical compatibility baseline, while contracts/samsara/README.md and the validator select the dated snapshot; no src, config, tests, or scripts reference root samsara.json as runtime/current authority.
root_baseline_disposition.recommendation: Leave the root file unchanged as a documented historical baseline. Keep every current-contract checker/report pinned to the dated path and digest; fail rather than fall back to root. Do not use the shared info.version string as freshness evidence.
